name: Spruce Health
one_liner: All-in-one healthcare communication platform with HIPAA-compliant messaging, video visits, phone system, and team collaboration for modern practices.
best_for: Practices seeking a unified communication platform (phone, text, video)
Mental health providers wanting HIPAA-compliant texting with patients
Clinicians who need a professional business phone line on personal devices
Group practices needing team messaging and call routing
Practices wanting to offer asynchronous care alongside video visits
not_for: Providers only needing video visits (Spruce is communication-focused)
Solo practitioners on tight budgets (pricing adds up)
Practices needing deep EHR integration or billing features
short_description: HIPAA-compliant communication platform combining secure messaging, video visits, VoIP phone system, and team collaboration for healthcare practices.
long_description: Spruce Health is a comprehensive healthcare communication platform that consolidates patient communication into a single HIPAA-compliant inbox. Unlike video-only telehealth platforms, Spruce provides a complete communication solution including secure text messaging, video visits, VoIP phone calls, voicemail, and fax, all accessible from a single app. Practices get a dedicated business phone number that works on personal smartphones, allowing providers to maintain work-life boundaries while staying accessible to patients. Spruce's team collaboration features include shared inboxes, internal messaging, task assignment, and call routing, making it ideal for group practices. The video visit feature integrates seamlessly with the messaging platform, allowing providers to easily transition from text to video when needed. Mental health practices appreciate Spruce for its ability to conduct asynchronous care through secure messaging, check in with patients between sessions, and maintain clear communication boundaries with a separate professional phone number.
patient_summary: HIPAA-compliant communication platform combining secure messaging, video visits, VoIP phone system, and team collaboration for healthcare practices.

pricing.notes: Per-user pricing. Volume discounts available for larger teams. 14-day free trial available.

privacy.notes: All communications (text, voice, video, fax) are HIPAA compliant with BAA.

seo.title: Spruce Health: HIPAA-Compliant Communication Platform
seo.meta_description: Spruce Health offers HIPAA-compliant messaging, video visits, and VoIP phone in one platform. Perfect for mental health practices. From $24/month per user.

faqs.q: What makes Spruce different from other telehealth platforms?
faqs.a: Spruce is a complete communication platform, not just video. You get secure texting, a professional phone number, video visits, voicemail, and fax in one HIPAA-compliant app. Patients text and call your Spruce number, keeping your personal number private.

faqs.q: Can patients text me directly through Spruce?
faqs.a: Yes, patients can send HIPAA-compliant text messages to your Spruce number. You receive messages in the Spruce app alongside voicemails, video visit requests, and team messages. Patient texts are encrypted and stored securely.

faqs.q: Do I need separate phone service if I use Spruce?
faqs.a: Spruce provides a complete business phone system including a dedicated phone number, VoIP calling, voicemail with transcription, and SMS. Many providers use Spruce as their primary practice phone, keeping personal and professional calls separate.

faqs.q: Is Spruce good for solo mental health practitioners?
faqs.a: Yes, the Basic plan ($24/month) is well-suited for solo practitioners who want secure patient communication and occasional video visits. However, if you only need video visits, a simpler platform like Doxy.me may be more cost-effective.
